card.fires_on: Mixed marks in news text: digits inside years and long numbers, colons after "said", and the word after a byline or title. Often a spot where a number or date comes next.

card.plain: It fires on odd spots in news text, mostly inside numbers, and tends to make a weekday or date less likely next.
